The parsEO dashboard lets you build CLMS filenames by clicking through schema fields, parse existing filenames, and validate schema JSON files — all powered by the parsEO API.

[Open the Dashboard &rarr;](dashboard.html)

> The dashboard connects to `parseo.mattiuzzi.com` for API calls. Make sure you have network access to it.

### Features

- **Clickable chip-tree** — build filenames by selecting values pill-by-pill
- **Live preview** — see the assembled filename update instantly
- **Parse** — paste a filename and get its parsed fields
- **Validate** — paste a schema JSON and run validation checks
- **Schema browser** — explore all parsEO schema families and versions
